text:
sofia: heads up — p99 jumped after the v7 rollout at 05:12 UTC. p50 untouched (~120ms) but p99 from ~180ms -> ~520ms, overall throughput down ~30%. KV cache hit rate dropped from 72% to 18% on the affected pool.

akshay: timeline? which pool / model variant?

sofia: rollout v7.0 -> variant:v7-2026-03-18 on pool:dedicated-gpu-3. Deployed 05:12, spike started ~05:15.

deploy-bot: [notice] deploy v7.0 -> dedicated-gpu-3 (sofia) at 05:12:04 UTC — strategy: canary 100%

marta: can we get a profiler snapshot (nsys/nsight) and kernel-decider logs for the period?

sofia: grabbing profiler — attaching trimmed logs below. kernel-decider log shows a switch to matmul_fallback path around 05:14:40 for many requests: 

```
[05:14:39.821] kernel-decider: seq_est=924 chosen_kernel=matmul_fallback reason=tile_mismatch
[05:14:39.822] kernel-decider: estimated_gflops=12.3 selected=matmul_fallback (latency penalty +40%)
[05:14:40.010] batcher: batch_size=1->3 queue_delay=15ms (up from 2ms)
[05:14:40.512] kvcache: hit=false key_lookup_misses=85% prefix_match_rate=12%
```

sofia: nsys trace (summary): matmul_fallback kernels account for ~58% GPU time, memcpy spikes + concurrent cudaMalloc retries.

akshay: tokenization change in v7? I remember a tokenizer tweak merged in the deploy PR — commit 1a2b3c changed subword merging for punctuation (meant to reduce tokens for english, but can inflate for mixed languages). Could that bump seq lengths + break prefix KV hits?

marta: I pulled per-request seq_len distribution — median roughly same, but 95th/99th jumped a lot. before v7: 95th=220,99th=480. after v7: 95th=360,99th=980. That alone would push kernel-decider heuristics into fallback territory.

ryan: also seeing host GPU memory pressure alerts around the same time (oom_killer-ish cuda OOM retries). infra-bot, any noisy neighbor events on the host?

infra-bot: [alert] host-gpu-19 memory_pressure high from 05:13:30 -> 05:19:00. Top consumer: tenant-342 (training job) pinned to same host.

sofia: interesting — two factors: tokenizer change increasing seq lengths and noisy neighbor eating GPU memory which forces kernel allocator to choose smaller/safer tiling (matmul_fallback). Combined effect = slower matmul + more batches + fewer KV hits.

akshay: can we A/B route a fraction back to v6 to confirm? if p99 drops back then tokenization is the main driver.

sofia: did 10% route to v6. p99 on the routed traffic stayed ~180ms, overall p99 for v7 cohort remained ~510ms. So v6 is fine.

marta: flame graph for v7 traffic attached — hotspot is matmul_fallback + memcpy. Also noticed increased time in tokenizer post-processing (token merge loops) for certain payloads (emoji + CJK mixed).

ryan: immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback tokenizer change in v7 (fast), 2) pin kernel-decider to prefer legacy tiled_matmul for small batches (unsafe perf regressions?) 3) evacuate noisy neighbor (move tenant-342). Which do we want now?

sofia: short term: evacuate noisy neighbor and revert tokenizer change for the canary. Doing both should restore KV hit rates and let kernel-decider pick fast path.

akshay: I'm taking the tokenizer rollback (PR & hotfix). ryan, can you coordinate moving tenant-342 off host-gpu-19? infra-bot, can you open a migration?

ryan: on it — kicking migration job now.

infra-bot: [task] migration started for tenant-342 -> host-gpu-21 at 05:26:10 UTC. ETA ~4m.

sofia: applying routing rollback to 0% for v7 in canary pool while hotfix lands.

deploy-bot: [action] set traffic v7.0 -> 0% on dedicated-gpu-3 by sofia at 05:27:03 UTC

marta: re-run perf snapshot after migration and rollback.

(5m later)

sofia: update: after migration + tokenizer rollback -> p99 back to ~190ms, throughput recovered ~+28%, KV cache hit rate back up to ~68%. Looks resolved.

marta: postmortem notes: root causes = tokenizer token-splitting change increasing seq_len tail + noisy neighbor GPU memory pressure causing kernel-decider to pick safe fallback kernel. Contributing factor: rollout was 100% canary.

akshay: actions: (1) add canary caps (max 10%) for model tokenizer-affecting changes — akshay owning, (2) add kernel-decider telemetry for tile_mismatch reasons + decision trace — marta owning, (3) improve preflight perf tests that simulate CJK/punct-heavy payloads — sofia owning, (4) host-level scheduling move to avoid colocating heavy training with latency-critical inference — ryan owning.

sofia: filing incident ticket and linking here. Thanks team :thumbsup:
